title: Transportation of Grove RT530E-2 Rough Terrain Crane
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.ENDIST ST PAUL.W07V ENDIST ST PAUL
description_text: The Maintenance and Repair (M and R) Section, Mississippi River Project Office, requires a services to transport one (1) Grove RT530E-2 Rough Terrain Crane from the Fountain City Service Base in Fountain City, Wisconsin to Reservation Dam near Wheaton, Minnesota, and return the equipment back to originating location in Fountain City, WI following completion of project work.
